_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-36 base rate over 7 days makes HOLD the statistically honest call despite the compelling macro analog; the structural bid is real but unconfirmed by price, so we wait for the breaker rather than guessing the breakout.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both agree the macro setup is risk-on and bullish, but the analyst calls UP while the coil's base rate dictates HOLD until confirmation.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.01% with ETF flows sustained >80 and DXY breaks below 99.0
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding turns negative with exchange netflow >80 (inflow panic) or VIX spikes above 20
